components.css: .ds-product-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--paper-soft); font-family: Lustria, Georgia, serif; } .ds-product-card__image { aspect-ratio: 1.26 / 1; background: var(--paper-secondary); transition: transform 430ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-product-card:hover .ds-product-card__image { transform: scale(1.025); } .ds-product-card__body { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; padding: 0.95rem 1rem 1rem; } .ds-product-card__category { color: var(--muted); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 0.59rem; letter-spacing: 0.11em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-product-card__title { display: flex; width: 100%; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.55rem; margin-top: 0.35rem; } .ds-product-card h3 { color: var(--espresso); font-family: Antic Didone, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.48rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.08; } .ds-product-card data { color: var(--espresso); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-product-card p { margin-top: 0.52rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.72rem; line-height: 1.48; } .ds-product-card a { min-height: 38px; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 0.55rem; color: var(--espresso); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-product-card a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.24em; } .ds-product-card a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--taupe); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: Café Boutique uses a light editorial page with generous paper fields, espresso anchors, fine dividers, and a warm serif pairing. Large source-backed photographs shape the home hero, product cards, story, kitchen, and gallery. The supplied logo remains an image asset; gaps in the media inventory remain unfilled.\n\nThe homepage moves from a split image-and-copy hero through product and category browsing, story, kitchen, gallery, values, aggregate rating, location, and contact. The full menu has its own searchable route. On mobile, featured products and category previews become horizontal scroll-snap carousels, while the full menu stays a list with compact selection controls.
keyCharacteristics: Light paper surfaces with espresso contrast, cream highlights, taupe details, and fine rules.
Antic Didone display type and Lustria reading type, each with Georgia serif fallback; Arial/Helvetica for interface controls.
Source-backed photography, rounded actions and cards, and mobile horizontal carousels.

rules.name: The Espresso Anchor Rule
rules.body: Use espresso for the strongest contrast; reserve cream and taupe for small highlights and interaction details.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep Antic Didone for headings and Lustria for reading copy; use Arial/Helvetica for interface controls and compact utility text.

rules.name: The Image-First Split Rule
rules.body: Keep the homepage hero at 45/55 copy-to-image on wide screens; at 760px and below, lead with the image and let the copy panel overlap its lower edge.

rules.name: The Tonal-Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate sections with the established warm surfaces and fine rules; do not add resting box shadows.

dos: Do use the exact palette and type roles in the frontmatter.
Do keep the supplied logo as its original image asset.
Do use only the provenance-tracked real photo and video files; leave unavailable photo slots null.
Do preserve the hero proportions, section order, and responsive horizontal carousel behavior.
Do keep menu, location, WhatsApp, and aggregate rating content tied to centralized source data.
donts: Don't add box shadows to resting surfaces; the implemented page has no shadow vocabulary.
Don't use generated food or café photography to fill missing media.
Don't invent Reel URLs, opening hours, product details, or review comments.
Don't replace the original logo with typeset brand text.
